scripts.text:
[Middle-Aged Man]
It's been a while since
someone has come this
way. Not too many people
pass by here, so I rarely
receive visitors. Why don't
you relax and chat for a while?
scripts.translation:
[中年男子]
好久没人来这边了。这里人迹罕至，我很少接待访客。不如放松一下，陪我聊会儿天？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What are you doing out
here in this secluded
area? You don't have
to work here, do you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你一个人待在这偏僻的地方做什么？你不用在这里工作吧？

scripts.text:
[Middle-Aged Man]
Well, just managing this
summer house gets me
enough income to get by.
Ah, I also craft various
things as sort of a hobby.
scripts.translation:
[中年男子]
嗯，光是打理这栋避暑别墅，收入就足够维持生计了。啊，我平时也会做些东西，算是兴趣爱好。

scripts.text:
[Middle-Aged Man]
Yeap, when I was younger,
I had my own forge in town.
It was a good family business,
and all of my siblings ended up
making wares for town lords
and even the royal family.
scripts.translation:
[中年男子]
没错，年轻时我在镇上有自己的铁匠铺。那是门家族生意，我的兄弟姐妹后来都为镇上的领主，甚至王室打造器物。

scripts.text:
[Middle-Aged Man]
But then, the accident
happened, and we had
to close shop. Well, that's
my story. Not a very happy
one, I gu ess, but otherwise
I've lived a long, good life.
scripts.translation:
[中年男子]
后来出了那场意外，我们只好关了店。嗯，这就是我的故事。算不上愉快吧，不过除此之外，我这一生过得还不错，也算长寿。

scripts.text:
[Middle-Aged Man]
Now what exactly
brings you here?
Are you just exploring
the land, or are you
hunting monsters, or...?
scripts.translation:
[中年男子]
那么，你到底为何来到这里？是来四处探访，还是狩猎魔物，抑或是...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, um,
I was led here by
this thing. It's called
the Seal of Muriniel.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，呃，我是被这个东西指引到这里的。
它叫做穆里尼尔之印。

scripts.text:
[Middle-Aged Man]
Oh... Oh my.
Let me see that.
Oh, yes. This is the
real thing. So... It's
finally found me. Well,
I guess I'm at your service.
scripts.translation:
[中年男子]
哦...天哪。让我看看。没错，这是真的。所以...它终于找到我了。看来我得听你差遣了。

scripts.text:
[Middle-Aged Man]
My name is Walker, and
my brothers and I were the 3
most talented blacksmiths
in Juno. Seeing as you've
been chosen by fate, we'll all
help you obtain a doomed sword.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
我叫沃克，我和兄弟们是朱诺最有天赋的三位铁匠。既然命运选中了你，我们都会帮你取得一把被诅咒的剑。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
First of all, the doomed
swords are sealed in magic
scrolls as pentagrams. When
their true owners appear, they
can be released by using
Muriniel's Seal.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
首先，那些被诅咒的剑被封在绘有五芒星的魔法卷轴里。真正的主人出现后，便能用穆里尼尔之印将它们解封。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
Now, for my part in unsealing
the doomed swords, I'll need
the highest quality materials.
Give me a few minutes and
I'll let you know what you
need to bring to me.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
我负责解除被诅咒之剑的封印，需要最高品质的材料。给我几分钟，我就告诉你需要带些什么来。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
Now, I should let you
know that I can only form
a portion of the pentagram
that will release one of the
doomed swords. You need my
brothers' help to complete it.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
先提醒你，我只能绘制解封其中一把被诅咒之剑所需五芒星的一部分。你还得请我的兄弟们帮忙，才能完成它。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
Once the pentagram
is complete and activated,
you will unseal the doomed
sword that is best suited to
you. I'm sorry, but I have no
way to predict what it may be.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
五芒星完成并启动后，最适合你的那把被诅咒之剑就会解封。抱歉，我无法预知它会是哪一把。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
For now, you must take
the first step and bring
me the following items.
Make sure to take note
of what I will require...
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
现在，你得先迈出第一步，把以下物品带给我。记下我需要的东西...

scripts.text:
[Walker]
I will need
^FF00001 Emperium^000000,
^FF00003 Tentacles^000000,
^FF000025 Amulets^000000,
^FF00001 Coal^000000, and
^FF00001 Necklace of Oblivion^000000.

[Walker]
Ah, very good.
You've brought
everything I need.
Now, please wait for
a moment while I finish
the preparations...
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
啊，非常好。
你带来了我需要的所有东西。
现在，请等我一下，让我完成最后的准备...

scripts.text:
[Walker]
Hmm...? You still
haven't brought me
everything I need to
begin the doomed sword
pentagram. Let me remind you
which materials to get for me.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
嗯...你还没带齐启动被诅咒之剑五芒星所需的材料。让我再告诉你一次需要准备什么。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
I will need
^FF00001 Emperium^000000,
^FF00003 Tentacles^000000,
^FF000025 Amulets^000000,
^FF00001 Coal^000000, and
^FF00001 Necklace of Oblivion^000000.

[Walker]
Ah, you're back.
I managed to finish this
sooner than I expected since
you gave me materials of
exceptionally good quality.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
啊，你回来了。你带来的材料品质格外好，所以我比预想中更快就完成了。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
Back when I was 15, my other
two brothers were taught by
Dwarves to create the pentragram that will release a doomed sword.
However, they taught each of us different parts of the pentagram.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
我15岁那年，另外两个兄弟跟矮人学会了绘制用来解封被诅咒之剑的五芒星。不过，矮人教给我们每个人的都是五芒星的不同部分。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
I guess the Dwarves split
up our knowledge because
they wanted to prolong the
return of the Executioner
sword within our generation.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
我想，矮人之所以把绘制方法拆开教，是为了推迟行刑者之剑在我们这一代重现。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
Originally, Executioner
was one of three swords
that the Dwarves were
ordered to forge for an evil
organization in exchange
for their village's safety.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
最初，行刑者是矮人受命为某个邪恶组织锻造的三把剑之一，他们这么做是为了换取村庄的平安。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
Despite their incredible
forging skills, the Dwarves
had difficulty procuring the
rare materials required to
forge the weapons within
the 15 day deadline.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
尽管矮人拥有非凡的锻造技艺，但要在15天期限内找到锻造这些武器所需的稀有材料，对他们来说并不容易。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
Desperate for help, the
Dwarves traveled to meet
my father, a renown smith
and adventurer at the time. He
was sympathetic to their plight
and gave them what they needed.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
当时走投无路的矮人前去拜访我的父亲。他是位声名远扬的铁匠兼冒险者，同情他们的遭遇，便把他们需要的材料给了他们。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
In gratitude for my father's
help, the Dwarves taught my
brothers how to create the
doomed sword pentagram,
but we could only complete
it if we all worked together.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
为了报答父亲的帮助，矮人教我的兄弟们绘制被诅咒之剑的五芒星。不过，只有我们齐心协力才能完成它。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
Sadly, I heard that the evil
organization that forced the
Dwarves to forge the swords
killed them when they refused
to give up their forging secrets.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
可惜我听说，那个逼迫矮人锻造这些剑的邪恶组织，在矮人拒绝交出锻造秘诀后杀害了他们。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
However, the Dwarves could
not reveal that the Executioner
was enchanted with a terrible
curse powered by the Dwarves'
hatred which threatens the life
of Executioner's wielder.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
然而，矮人没能透露行刑者受到可怕的诅咒：诅咒的力量源于矮人的仇恨，会危及持剑者的性命。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
Oh, don't worry too much.
If you happen to obtain the
Executioner, the seal should
have weakened the curse
enough so that it won't kill
you that quickly. Well, then...
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
哦，不必太担心。若你真的得到行刑者，封印应该已经削弱了诅咒，至少不会让它那么快要了你的命。好了...

scripts.text:
[Walker]
You should visit my brother
Morf for the next part of the
doomed sword pentagram.
Morf should be easy to find,
as he's usually drinking
all day in Payon's tavern.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
接下来，你该去找我的兄长莫尔夫，继续完成被诅咒之剑的五芒星。莫尔夫很好找，他通常整天都在斐扬的酒馆里喝酒。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
Please, take this scroll
with the pentagram with you,
and give my regards to Morf
once you see him. If you do
succeed in obtaining a doomed sword, use its power responsibly.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
请带上这张绘有五芒星的卷轴，见到莫尔夫时替我向他问好。如果你成功取得一把被诅咒之剑，务必谨慎使用它的力量。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
Look for my older
brother Morf in the
tavern in Payon-- He's
always drinking over there.
Hopefully, he'll help you finish the doomed sword pentagram.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
去斐扬的酒馆找我的哥哥莫尔夫——他总是在那里喝酒。希望他能帮你完成被诅咒之剑的五芒星。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
Ah, so you've
already met with
Morf? When you get
the chance, please give
him my regards and let
him know that I'm doing well.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
啊，你已经见过莫尔夫了？有机会的话，请代我向他问好，并告诉他我过得很好。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
Ah, so you've
already met with
Morf? When you get
the chance, please give
him my regards and let
him know that I'm doing well.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
啊，你已经见过莫尔夫了？有机会的话，请代我向他问好，并告诉他我过得很好。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
So how has Morf been?
I know he's eccentric, and
perhaps a little rude, but
he's really a very good man.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
莫尔夫最近怎么样？我知道他有些古怪，也许还有点粗鲁，但他其实是个很好的人。

scripts.text:
[Walker]
It's good that Morf
was able to help you.
As for our younger brother,
Huey, I haven't heard from
him in a while. I think he's
travelling around in Morocc?
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
莫尔夫能帮到你，真是太好了。至于我们的弟弟休伊，我有段时间没收到他的消息了。我想他正在梦罗克一带旅行？

scripts.text:
[Walker]
I trust that Huey
is taking good care
of himself. If you happen
to see him again, would
you ask him to come visit
me one of these days?
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
我相信休伊会照顾好自己。如果你再见到他，能请他改天来看看我吗？

scripts.text:
[Walker]
Oh! You've completed
the pentagram and come
into possession of one of
the doomed swords? I'm
glad to hear it. If Father were
alive, he would be so proud.
scripts.translation:
[沃克]
哦！你完成了五芒星，并得到了一把被诅咒之剑？听到这个消息我很高兴。父亲要是还在世，一定会非常自豪。

scripts.text:
[Middle-Aged Man]
It's been a while since
someone has come this
way. Not too many people
pass by here, so I rarely
receive visitors. Feel free
to rest and relax a while~
scripts.translation:
[中年男子]
好久没人来这边了。这里人迹罕至，我很少接待访客。请随意休息放松一会儿吧~

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Wha--? Who are
you? Whaddya want?
Lemme alone so I can
drink in peace! ^333333*Urp*^000000
scripts.translation:
[老人]
什...？你是谁？想干什么？别打扰我，让我安静地喝酒！^333333*Urp*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um, excuse me, but are
you Morf? I'm been sent
by your brother, Walker,
to ask if you can help
me with this pentagram.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下，请问您是莫尔夫吗？您的兄弟沃克派我来，想请您帮我完成这个五芒星。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Huh...? Lemme see...
Oh. This is Walker's
work alright. Y-you really
want a doomed sword, huh?
A-and that's really the Seal
of Muriel you have there?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嗯...让我看看...哦，没错，这确实是沃克的手艺。你...你真想要一把被诅咒的剑？而且你手里的真是穆里尼尔之印？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, the Seal!
Here, take a look
if you want. If it's
not the real thing, then
I went through a lot of
trouble to get a fake.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，是穆里尼尔之印！你想看的话就拿去看吧。要是它是假的，那我之前岂不是费了好大劲才弄到一个假货。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Arrrgh! That's the real
thing! Does this mean
I have to really work on
this now?! I'm still drunk!
Damn... I guess I have no
choice but to sober up.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
Arrrgh! 这是真的！难道我现在真的得干活了？！我还醉着呢！该死...看来只好先醒醒酒了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Ugh... But I'm gonna
have such a hangover.
Hey! Bring me 20 Yellow
Potions so I can nurse
the headache I'm gonna
have! I'll need them so bad...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
Ugh...我肯定会宿醉。喂，给我拿20瓶黄色药水来，好缓解待会儿的头痛！我可太需要它们了...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Oh, thank goodness you've
brought me the potions! Now,
these'll help me cope with the
unfamiliar sensation that you
people call sobriety. Ugh...
I can think clearly... Damn!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
谢天谢地，你把药水带来了！这下我就能应付你们所说的“清醒”这种陌生感觉了。Ugh...我现在居然能想清楚了...该死！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Gimme the scroll
with the pentagram.
Let's see, here. Hey,
Walker did a great job
on this. Alright, listen.
This is what I need from you...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
把画着五芒星的卷轴给我。让我看看...嘿，沃克做得不错。好了，听着，我需要你准备这些东西...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
^FF00001 Coal^000000,
^FF00003 Trunks^000000,
^FF00003 Old Hilts^000000,
^FF000050 Orge Teeth^000000, and
^FF00001 Foolishness of the Blind^000000.

[Old Man]
You have to bring me
those items so that I can
continue forming the doomed
sword pentagram. I'll just be
waiting for you right here.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
把这些东西带给我，我才能继续绘制被诅咒之剑的五芒星。我就在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Arrrgh! Did you bring
me 20 Yellow Potions?
This hangover is getting
worse and worse! H-hurry
up and get me my meds!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
啊！你带20瓶黄色药水来了吗？我的宿醉越来越严重了！快...快把药给我！

scripts.text:
[Morf]
Hey, you've brought
everything? Good, the
sooner I get this done,
the sooner I can get back
to drinking. All you need
to do now is sit and wait.
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
嘿，你把东西都带齐了？很好，我越快做完，就能越快回去喝酒。你现在只要坐着等就行。

scripts.text:
[Morf]
Alright. Let's get...
Started? Where did I put
that thing I needed? Um...
Ah, there we go. Hrrrm...
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
好，那我们开...始？我要用的东西放哪儿了？嗯...啊，找到了。嗯...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
H-hey, when is this
thing going to be finished?
Isn't it about time already?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等、等一下，这东西什么时候才能做完？差不多该好了吧？

scripts.text:
[Morf]
Hey! Be patient,
you can't rush
perfection. It'll
take as long as it
has to. But yeah,
I'm almost finished...
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
嘿，耐心点，完美可急不来。该花多少时间就得花多少时间。不过嘛，我快做完了...

scripts.text:
[Morf]
Just...
Just give me a
few more minutes...
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
就...再给我几分钟...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
What, did you forget
what I need? Grrr, I'll
tell you again, but you
better not forget this time!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
什么，你忘了我需要什么吗？哼，我再告诉你一次，这次最好别忘了！

scripts.text:

^FF00001 Coal^000000,
^FF00003 Trunks^000000,
^FF00003 Old Hilts^000000,
^FF000050 Orge Teeth^000000, and
^FF00001 Foolishness of the Blind^000000.

[Morf]
Ooh, my back~!
The searing pain!
It looks like I have
no choice but to take
a break. That's why you
shouldn't be pushing me!
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
Ooh，我的背~疼得火辣辣的！看来我只好休息一下了。所以才叫你别催我！

scripts.text:
[Morf]
Hey, while we've got some
time, let me tell you a story
about Mysteltainn, one of the
doomed swords that you may
receive if you manage to
complete the pentagram.
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
趁还有时间，我给你讲讲妖剑弒光的故事吧。只要你完成五芒星，就有机会从封印中得到这把被诅咒的剑。

scripts.text:
[Morf]
Now, Mysteltainn is the
name of the tree from which
the twig that was used to
kill Baldur, god of light, was
obtained. It was the only
thing that could harm Baldur...
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
妖树弑光是那棵树的名字，杀死光之神巴尔德的树枝就取自那里。那根树枝是唯一能伤害巴尔德的东西...

scripts.text:
[Morf]
From what I remember, the
god Loki plotted to kill Baldur
because he was jealous of
the god of light that every
living thing and inanimate
object seemed to adore.
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
据我所知，洛基策划杀死巴尔德，是因为嫉妒这位光之神。万物生灵乃至无生命之物似乎都对他顶礼膜拜。

scripts.text:
[Morf]
Loki tricked Baldur's mother
into revealing Baldur's secret
weakness. Now, the gods regularly made a game of throwing objects
like darts at Baldur since he was immune to everything else.
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
洛基骗巴尔德的母亲说出了巴尔德的弱点。因为巴尔德不受其他任何东西伤害，众神便常玩向他投掷飞镖等物品的游戏。

scripts.text:
[Morf]
When he learned that
Mysteltainn could be used
to kill Baldur, he took one of
its twigs and tricked Baldur's
blind brother into throwing it at Baldur in one of their games.
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
洛基得知弒光的树枝能杀死巴尔德后，便折下一根树枝，诱骗巴尔德失明的兄弟在游戏中将它掷向巴尔德。

scripts.text:
[Morf]
And so...
That was how the
god of light was killed.
By Loki's trickery and the
foolishness of the blind.
That's Mysteltainn's story.
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
就这样...
光之神被杀死了。
死于洛基的诡计，也死于盲人的愚行。
这就是弒光的故事。

scripts.text:
[Morf]
Now, if you do happen to
get the Mysteltainn doomed
sword from its seal, it won't
be as powerful as the original
one that, you know, killed a
god. It can't be reproduced...
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
如果你真的从封印中得到妖剑弒光，它不会像那把弑神的原版一样强大。毕竟，原版无法复制...

scripts.text:
[Morf]
However, the fascimile is
incredibly powerful, and you
must make sure that you wield
it responsibly. Now, I know
you must be upset that I've
taken so long to do this...
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
不过，这把仿制品依然威力惊人，你必须谨慎使用。我知道，让你等了这么久，你一定很不耐烦...

scripts.text:
[Morf]
Please understand that
I'm pretty old now, and that
pentagram work isn't exactly
easy. Anyway, my part is done.
Now you gotta find Huey,
my youngest brother.
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
请体谅一下，我年纪大了，绘制五芒星可不轻松。总之，我这部分已经完成。接下来去找我最小的弟弟休伊吧。

scripts.text:
[Morf]
Huey's been traveling
around, but last I heard, he
was in Morocc. If you can
find him, he can complete
this pentagram for you. Well,
care now, and good luck.
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
休伊一直在四处旅行，不过我最后听说他在梦罗克。如果你能找到他，他就能替你完成五芒星。好了，保重，祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Morf]
Be patient, youngster,
I need more time! Don't
you understand that if
I screw up this pentagram,
you'll have to start all over
again? Yeah, that's right~
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
耐心点，小鬼，我还需要些时间！要是我把五芒星弄坏了，你就得从头再来。听明白了吗~

scripts.text:
[Morf]
Not... Done... Yet.
It'll be done when it's
done, okay? Why don't you
take a walk or something
to kill the time, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
还...没...好呢。做完了自然会告诉你，行吗？你不如去散散步什么的，打发一下时间？

scripts.text:
[Morf]
Yeah, you know what?
It's time for another break.
Let me rest my cramped hands
and enjoy one of these Yellow
Potions that you've brought
me. Yep, that's a good idea.
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
对了，你知道吗？该再休息一会儿了。让我活动活动僵硬的手，再喝一瓶你带来的黄色药水。嗯，这主意不错。

scripts.text:
[Morf]
Look...
If you're just
gonna stand there
and breathe down my
neck while I'm working,
you might as well be useful.
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
听着...如果你只会站在那儿，在我工作时还贴着我催个不停，那不如帮点忙。

scripts.text:
[Mork]
Bring me some
snacks or something,
or get the hell out of
here until I'm done!
scripts.translation:
[莫克]
给我带点零食什么的，不然就等我做完再来，别在这儿碍事！

scripts.text:
^3355FFMorf has fallen
into a deep sleep.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF莫尔夫陷入了沉睡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Morf]
No...
Still not done.
Just like the last
time you asked.
Just... Wait...
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
不...还没好。就像你上次问的时候一样。再...等等...

scripts.text:
^3355FFMorf has fallen
into a pretty restful
slumber that he seems
to be thoroughly enjoying.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF莫尔夫陷入了酣睡，似乎睡得十分惬意。^000000

scripts.text:
[Morf]
You can see my hands, right?
When they're not busy trying
to finish this pentagram, that's probably a sign meaning that 
I'm finished. Lookee, they're
moving, still moving, see that?
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
你看得到我的手吧？要是它们没在忙着画五芒星，那大概就说明我画完了。看，它们还在动...还在动，瞧见了吗？

scripts.text:
[Morf]
If you really want to
finish that pentagram,
then find my youngest
brother Huey in Morocc.
He should help you out.
I mean, if I did, then he will!
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
如果你真的想完成五芒星，就去梦罗克找我最小的弟弟休伊。他应该会帮你的。我肯定会帮你，所以他也会！

scripts.text:
[Morf]
You actually found
Huey? How's my little
baby brother doing? Well,
if he's fine, then make him
finish that pentagram. I don't want all my work to go to waste!
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
你真的找到休伊了？我小弟弟怎么样？他要是没事，就让他把五芒星完成吧。我可不想白忙一场！

scripts.text:
[Morf]
It's good to hear
that Huey is fine and
that nothing's wrong with
his health. In that case,
he should be writing me
and Walker more often!
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
听说休伊没事，身体也健康，真让人放心。既然如此，他应该多给我和沃克写信才对！

scripts.text:
[Morf]
Now that you have one
of those doomed swords,
I want you to only use it for
the right reasons. The curses
of the swords are most dangerous when your conviction wavers.
scripts.translation:
[莫尔夫]
既然你已经得到一把被诅咒之剑，我希望你只为正当目的使用它。只要你的信念动摇，剑上的诅咒就会变得格外危险。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Arrrrrrrrrghhhh~!
My heart freakin' hurts!
Times like these, I sure
could use a Yellow Potion to
help cope with my hangovers.
C'mon, I freakin' need my meds!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
Arrrrrrrrrghhhh~! 我的心脏疼死了！这种时候真该来瓶黄色药水缓解宿醉。快点，我真的需要药！

scripts.text:
[Huey]
Excuse me, but...
Um, did you need
something? You
look like you have
a question for me.
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
打扰一下...呃，你需要什么吗？看起来你有问题想问我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, I'm looking for
somebody named Huey.
I hear he's the only one
that can help me finish
this... well... Do you know
where I can find him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，我在找一个叫休伊的人。听说只有他能帮我完成这个...呃...你知道我能在哪里找到他吗？

scripts.text:
[Huey]
Y-yes. I-I'm Huey.
But why are you looking
for me? Oh! Are you some
kind of messenger from one
of my brothers? I haven't heard
from them in quite a while.
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
是、是的，我就是休伊。你为什么找我？啊，你是我哪位哥哥派来的信使吗？我已经很久没收到他们的消息了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, I'm trying to
obtain a doomed sword.
To do that, I've already
got the Seal of Muriniel,
and your brothers have
started this pentagram.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，我想得到一把被诅咒的剑。为此，我已经拿到了穆里尼尔之印，你的哥哥们也开始绘制五芒星了。

scripts.text:
[Huey]
Are you serious?
You've come this far to
get one of those accursed
blades? Mm, would you please
let me see the pentagram? Oh,
my brothers did such good work!
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
你说真的？你走了这么远，就是为了得到一把被诅咒的剑？嗯...能让我看看五芒星吗？哦，哥哥们做得真好！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, yes. Here.

[Huey]
I don't know if you can
appreciate it, but this
pentagram has really good
craftsmanship! Now, if my
older brothers have already helped you, I shall do the same.
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
不知你能不能看出来，这个五芒星的工艺真是精湛！既然哥哥们已经帮了你，我也会出一份力。

scripts.text:
[Huey]
My older brothers are even
better blacksmiths than me,
so if you were able to convince
them to aid you, I don't really
have the right to refuse to help you. Besides, if I don't...
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
哥哥们的锻造技艺都比我高明。既然你能说服他们帮忙，我实在没有理由拒绝。再说，如果我不帮忙...

scripts.text:
[Huey]
...Then my brother's work
would have been for nothing.
And then... They might just
come looking for me. Morf
especially. Oh, right! Materials! I need these for the pentagram!
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
...那哥哥们的心血就白费了。他们说不定会来找我，尤其是莫尔夫。啊，对了！材料！我需要这些来完成五芒星！

scripts.text:
[Huey]
Please bring me
^FF00009 Rubies^000000,
^FF00006 Blades of Darkness^000000,
^FF00009 Bloody Edges^000000, and
^FF00001 Loki's Whisper^000000.

[Huey]
While you gather the
necessary items, I'll be
finishing my preparations.
Oh, and bring me the ^FF0000exact
amounts^000000--^FF0000no more^000000, ^FF0000no less^000000.
Okay now, I'll see you later~
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
你收集材料时，我会继续准备。哦，带来的数量必须^FF0000刚刚好^000000——^FF0000不能多^000000，^FF0000也不能少^000000。好了，回头见~

scripts.text:
[Huey]
Oh, you're back. Did
you bring everything
I need for the pentagram
in the exact amounts? Mmm...
Ah! Yes, perfect! Nice work~
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
哦，你回来了。制作五芒星的材料都带齐了吗？数量也刚刚好？嗯...啊！没错，完美！干得好~

scripts.text:
[Huey]
Would you please wait
while I finish this pentagram?
This is going to take some
time, but trust me, we're
almost done. All your hard
work will pay off soon~
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
请稍等，让我完成这个五芒星。这需要一点时间，不过相信我，我们快完成了。你付出的努力很快就会有回报~

scripts.text:
[Huey]
In order to finish the
pentagram, I'll need some
items in the exact quantities--
no more, no less. If you have
too many of a required item, why don't you put it in your Storage?
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
要完成五芒星，材料的数量必须刚刚好——不能多，也不能少。如果某种材料带多了，不如把多余的存进仓库？

scripts.text:
[Huey]
Please bring me
^FF00009 Rubies^000000,
^FF00006 Blades of Darkness^000000,
^FF00009 Bloody Edges^000000, and
^FF00001 Loki's Whisper^000000.
Well, I'll be waiting~
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
请带来
^FF00009颗红宝石^000000，
^FF00006把黑暗之刃^000000，
^FF00009把血染之刀^000000，
以及^FF00001个洛基的低语^000000。
我会在这里等你~

scripts.text:
[Huey]
Hey there, your timing's
perfect! I just completed
the pentagram for unsealing
one of the doomed swords.
There's just one last step...
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
嘿，你来得正是时候！我刚完成了解封一把被诅咒之剑的五芒星。现在只差最后一步...

scripts.text:
[Huey]
Would you put the Seal of Murinel to the pentagram? That will unlock
the seal, causing the doomed sword best suited for you to manifest.
Soon, Grimtooth, Mysteltainn,
or Executioner will be yours...
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
请把穆里尼尔之印放到五芒星上。这样就能解开封印，让最适合你的那把被诅咒之剑显现。很快，魔短剑闇噬、妖剑弒光或行刑者就会属于你...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou carefully place the
Seal of Muriniel to the
pentagram. A few parts of
the pentagram immediately
begin to quitely pulse with
a soft and gentle glow.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你小心翼翼地将穆里尼尔之印放到五芒星上。五芒星的几处立刻开始轻柔地脉动，泛起柔和的光芒。^000000

scripts.text:
[Huey]
It's... It's starting! The
sections of the pentagram
are activating in the order
in which they were completed.
The parts that are lit now
must be Walker's work...
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
开...开始了！五芒星的各个部分正按照完成的先后顺序依次启动。现在亮起的部分一定是沃克完成的...

scripts.text:
^3355FFSuddenly, another section
of the pentagram activates,
and parts of the pentagram
flare unstably with an
intense, unsteady light.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF突然，五芒星的另一部分也启动了，几处符文随即迸发出强烈而不稳定的光芒。^000000

scripts.text:
[Huey]
That must be...
Morf must have done
that part. Okay, when
the light stabilizes and
the entire pentagram is
glowing, it'll be ready.
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
那一定是...莫尔夫完成的部分。好，等光芒稳定下来，整个五芒星都亮起时，就准备好了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe unactivated portions
of the pentagram ignite,
and the entire pentagram
emits a warm, effusive glow.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF五芒星尚未启动的部分也骤然亮起，整个五芒星散发出温暖而耀眼的光芒。^000000

scripts.text:
[Huey]
Okay, this is important!
One of the doomed swords
is going to manifest very soon.
When you can see the sword
within the light, grab it quickly!
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
好了，注意！一把被诅咒之剑马上就要显现了。看见光芒中的剑时，赶紧抓住它！

scripts.text:
[Huey]
Wait, can you--?
There, I see it! Now
quickly, take it! It's yours!
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
等等，你能——？
看到了！快，拿起来！它归你了！

scripts.text:
[Huey]
So how are you handling
that doomed sword? Whatever
you do, don't abuse its power
and you should be fine. I've
got faith that you'll never
succumb to the blade's curse.
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
那把被诅咒之剑用起来怎么样？无论如何，别滥用它的力量，就不会有事。我相信你绝不会屈服于剑上的诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Huey]
Anyway, I really
should thank you for
the opportunity to use
my skills. I mean, I didn't
want what I had learned from
the Dwarves to go to waste.
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
总之，我真的该谢谢你让我有机会施展本领。我不想白白浪费从矮人那里学来的技艺。

scripts.text:
[Huey]
You know, I've traveled
to all sorts of places, but
the heat here in Morocc
is the worst I've ever
experienced! It's so humid
and uncomfortable here...
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
我去过不少地方，但梦罗克的酷热是我经历过最难熬的！这里又闷又潮，真不舒服...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou reach within the
blinding light and grasp
the sword's handle. When
the light dissipates, you
can see that you have
obtained a {0}.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你伸手探入刺眼的光芒，握住剑柄。光芒消散后，你发现自己获得了{0}。^000000

scripts.text:
[Huey]
Hold on, you're carrying
too many things with you.
You better store some things
to make more of your inventory
space available. Then, we can finally claim your doomed sword.
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
等一下，你身上带的东西太多了。先把一些物品存起来，腾出背包空间。之后我们才能把被诅咒之剑交给你。

scripts.text:
[Huey]
Th-that's the Grimtooth!
Ever since I've been taught
the pentagram techniques by
those Dwarves, I've never once
imagined that I'd see that sword. Please use that weapon wisely.
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
那...那是魔短剑闇噬！自从矮人教我绘制五芒星以来，我从没想过还能亲眼见到这把剑。请谨慎使用它。

scripts.text:
[Huey]
I don't believe it!
You... You've been found
worthy of the Mysteltainn?
Be careful, and don't let
its power overwhelm you.
Wield it only for just ends...
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
我不敢相信！你...你竟然被认定有资格持有妖剑弒光？小心，别被它的力量压垮。只把它用于正当之事...

scripts.text:
[Huey]
Th-that's...!
The Executionier has
chosen you to wield it?
You must have an extremely
strong will, or something...
Don't give in to the bloodlust.
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
那...那是...！行刑者选中你来挥舞它了？你的意志一定极其坚定...千万别屈服于它的嗜血本性。

scripts.text: [Huey]
scripts.translation: [休伊]

scripts.text:
[Huey]
Well, it looks like my
work here is done. I'm glad
I got the chance to use these
ancient skills, and it's an honor to meet a worthy adventurer.
My brothers should be proud.
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
嗯，我这边的工作总算完成了。能施展这些古老技艺，我很高兴；能遇到一位合格的冒险者，更是我的荣幸。哥哥们一定会为我骄傲。

scripts.text:
[Huey]
Speaking of which,
please give Morf and
Walker my regards if you
happen to see them. Well
then, take care of yourself, and be cautious in using that sword.
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
说起来，如果你碰巧见到莫尔夫和沃克，请代我向他们问好。保重，也要谨慎使用那把剑。
